pages.title: Dream Filling
pages.text: A Gummy Bear turns potion effects into another portable form.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Feed the bear a potion, let it hibernate and provide Licoroot after waking. Matching-color Sweetish Fish breed bears; feeding without resulting beans does not count.

pages.title: Field notes
pages.text: Use a Soda Bucket for Sweetish Fish or cook them into gelatin. Matching fish colors serve bears and gelatin recipes, not a required all-color collection.

pages.title: Practical note
pages.text: Collect Jelly Beans matching a potion fed to a Gummy Bear. Feed the bear a potion, let it hibernate and provide Licoroot after waking. Matching-color Sweetish Fish breed bears; feeding without resulting beans does not count.
